sentences.text: 2. Necessary insertion in the cause title of the writ petition be made by learned counsel for the petitioner in course of the day.

3. Issue notice to the newly impleaded respondent no.7.
4.
Mr. Mohan Kumar Dubey, learned A.C. to A.G. appears and waives notice on behalf of the said respondent.

5. The present writ petition has been filed for issuance of direction upon the concerned respondents not to make any construction over the petitioner's land appertaining to Plot No.437, Khata No.20,
Mouza-Bhandaridih, Halka No.9, Thana No.578, Police Station-Taratand, Circle Gandey, District- Giridih measuring an area of 1.30 acres without lawfully acquiring the same and/or making payment of appropriate compensation for the same at the present market rate under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 6. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has raiyati right over the land in question.

The name of the petitioner's father (Babulal Pandit) has been mutated with respect to the land in question and details of the same has also been entered at Page-23 of Register-II, Volume-7 maintained in the office of the Circle Officer, Gandey.
Moreover, the rent-receipt for the said land has been issued till the year 2004-05.

7. It is further submitted that the name of petitioner's father with respect to the said land has also been uploaded in the on-line Register-II being maintained on the portal of National Generic Document Registration System (NGDRS).

Despite the aforesaid facts, the respondent nos.4 and 5 are getting a health sub-centre constructed over the said land of the petitioner by awarding the construction work to the respondent no.6-Baba Construction Pvt. Ltd.
8.

It is also submitted that the petitioner being aggrieved with the said situation, represented the respondent authorities, however, the same remained un-responded which has compelled him to prefer the present writ petition.
9.

Mr. Mohan Kumar Dubey, learned A.C. to A.G. appearing on behalf of the respondent nos.1 to 5 and 7 submits that aforesaid claim of the petitioner is required to be factually examined by the competent authority.
Hence, if he prefers a fresh representation before the respondent no.7, an appropriate decision in accordance with law will be taken by the said respondent within a time frame.

10. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the nature of the prayer made by the petitioner in the present writ petition, without entering into the merit of the case, the petitioner is given liberty to prefer a fresh representation on the present issue before the respondent no.7.

On receipt of the said representation, the respondent no.7 after examining the relevant records and on providing an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner, shall take appropriate informed decision in accordance with law within a period of two months from the date of filing of the said representation.
